pages.text: Makes nuclear waste safe. Each $(l)Depleted Fuel Rod$() takes 10 seconds and $(l)40 FE/t$() and becomes a block of $(l)Vitrified Waste$(); one time in three it also recovers an $(l)Uranium Ingot$(), and one time in four an $(l)Isotope Shard$(), the seed of the $(l:mech/mech_core)Mech Core$(/l)'s crystal.$(br)$(li)$(l:nuclear/radiation)Depleted Fuel Rod$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(item)Vitrified Waste$()$(br)$(li)$(l:nuclear/uranium)Uranium Ingot$(/l)

$(li)$(item)Isotope Shard$()$(br)$(li)Waste waiting inside the Reprocessor is $(l)shielded$(): it does not contaminate.$(br)$(li)Automate it: a hopper under a $(l)Reactor Port$() pulls Depleted Fuel Rods out of the reactor, and a hopper into the Reprocessor feeds them in. Hoppers below take the products out.
$(li)$(l)Vitrified Waste$() is inert glass: store it anywhere, or build with it.
